message:
The vulnerability is a use-of-uninitialized-value in `ZSTD_rawLiteralsCost`. The issue is that `literals[u]` reads from the `literals` buffer, which may contain uninitialized data. Let me look at the git history to understand the fix and the regression.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/zstd && git log --oneline --all -- lib/compress/zstd_opt.c | head -20 && echo "---" && git log --all --oneline --grep="msan" | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
